title: Financial Analyst (FP&A)
summary: Financial analysts in FP&A (financial planning and analysis) build the company's budget and forecasts, track actual results against them and explain why numbers moved. They sit in the finance team and work closely with business heads and the CFO to guide spending and targets.
dailyDuties: Update the rolling forecast with inputs from business teams
Compare actual results with budget and explain the variances
Build or update financial models for new plans and investments
Prepare the monthly management report and leadership deck
Review cost centre spending with department heads
Work with accounting on month-end accruals and close numbers

skills.expectation: Build the annual budget and rolling forecasts with business teams
Build driver-based and scenario models for plans and investments
Explain budget-versus-actual variances and prepare monthly management reports
Read the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow and work with accounting at month-end
Work in advanced Excel every day
Partner with business and department heads on costs and targets
Present numbers and insights clearly to senior leaders
Use pivot tables and lookups to shape large data sets
Use a planning tool such as Anaplan, Hyperion, SAP BPC or Adaptive Planning
Build finance dashboards in Power BI
Build business cases and ROI analysis for new investments
Pull finance data with simple SQL queries
